title: REST YOUR MIND
PHILIPPIANS 4:8
end: The Secret Place — prayers every day
stock_queries: soft candlelight in quiet room night
calm mountain lake glowing night moon
gentle ocean waves under moonlight night
cozy bedroom warm lamp light evening
misty pine forest at night starry canopy
still waters reflecting dark starry night sky

scenes.a: If your mind is racing with replay of every mistake made today, rest now.
Finally, brethren, whatsoever things are true, whatsoever things are honest, whatsoever things are just,
whatsoever things are pure, whatsoever things are lovely, whatsoever things are of good report;
if there be any virtue, and if there be any praise, think on these things.
Lord, fill this quiet bedroom with your gentle peace. Wash away every noisy anxiety, replay, and fearful thought.
Anchor my heart upon your goodness and beauty tonight. Give me restful sleep in your presence.
